# StatusChip

Renders any domain status as a glyph plus a label in its tone.

`AIA.StatusChip` · Status

## Use

```jsx
<AIA.StatusChip kind="StageStatus" value="…">…</AIA.StatusChip>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AIA.StatusChip" kind="StageStatus" value="…">…</x-import>
```
